title: Ensure 'Application: Specify the maximum log file size (KB)' is set to 'Enabled: 32,768 or greater'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Event Log Service\Application\Specify the maximum log file size (KB) to 'Enabled: 32768'
reason: Ensuring that the Application Event log is large enough to store sufficient data.

title: Ensure 'Security: Specify the maximum log file size (KB)' is set to 'Enabled: 196,608 or greater'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Event Log Service\Security\Specify the maximum log file size (KB) to 'Enabled: 196608'
reason: The Security Event log contains critical security events and needs sufficient capacity.

title: Ensure 'System: Specify the maximum log file size (KB)' is set to 'Enabled: 32,768 or greater'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Event Log Service\System\Specify the maximum log file size (KB) to 'Enabled: 32768'
reason: Ensuring that the System Event log is large enough to store sufficient data.
